test_ViewSampler_compare_naive: test the ViewSampler module by comparing its output against the naive view sampling implementation
test_ViewSampler_viewsampling: test the ViewSampler module by generating a viewsampling problem and comparing output to expected results
run_view_sample_naive: run the naive view sampling implementation to sample features and masks from source views for 3D points
run_sample_one_view_naive: run the naive single view sampling to project 3D points and sample features from a camera view
init_view_sampler_problem: create a synthetic view-sampling problem with 3D points, cameras, features, masks, and sequence IDs
